steps.what: List open specifications and budgets for this subcontract.
Supervise subcontractors or consultants to ensure quality and conformance.
Record the conformance the manager observed.

tasks.design: Open specifications and budgets for the subcontract are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager supervises the subcontractors or consultants and judges quality and conformance. An item with no specification id is not listed. The list does not score a person. The manager writes what was observed in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specification gaps were found on site because the open items were not in one list.
tasks.enabler_now: The subcontract record can list the specification items and budgets already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the work conforms is seen on site. A list cannot see it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager watches the work and decides if it meets the specification.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays on site with the manager. The list only shows open specification items.

reach.learn: An open specification item is not a judgement of the person.

evidence.claim: A subcontract record can list open specification items and budget lines. It cannot watch the work.
EU AI Act Annex III 4(a) covers evaluation of people. A conformance list must not score the subcontractor. The manager supervises.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A subcontract id and a specification id are required. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: The list is of work items, not a score of a person.
unknowns: Whether consultants are engaged on the same subcontract record as builders.
research_questions: Which quality points are still passed on verbally and never written down?

already_counted.description: Supervising the work and recording what was observed stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Check the open-item list is the subcontract the manager is about to visit.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes specification items have no id, so the manager prepares the visit notes by hand. High assumes the subcontract record lists them. The site supervision is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Copy headings for design, site assessment, environmental studies, surveying, and field support.
Develop the scope of work for those project functions and services.
Check the scope names every function it must cover.

tasks.design: Headings for design, site assessment, environmental studies, surveying, and field support are copied from a prior scope in {DOCS} only where that scope is one the company may reuse. The manager develops the scope of work for those functions. A heading is not the study. The manager checks that each required function is named.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each scope was started from a blank page, including the functions that repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: A prior scope the company holds can supply headings. The manager still writes the scope.
tasks.still_hard: What this site must study is a judgement. A heading from another project is not that judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the scope. Copied headings only stop a function being forgotten.
tasks.altitude: The scope is the manager's text. Headings from an earlier scope are a prompt, not the scope.

reach.role: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
reach.task: Set the scope of a site study.
reach.learn: A reused heading does not decide what this site needs.

evidence.claim: Headings can be copied from a scope the company already holds. The new scope is still written by the manager.
An environmental study heading is not the study, and it is not a decision that the study is complete.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A prior scope id is required before a heading is copied. A missing id stops the copy. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: The manager writes the scope text. Copied headings are labels only.
unknowns: Whether the company is allowed to reuse the prior scope or only its function names.
research_questions: Which functions are commissioned outside the written scope?

already_counted.description: Writing the scope and checking its coverage stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Check copied headings belong to a scope the company may reuse.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes there is no reusable prior scope, so the manager writes every heading. High assumes the function names can be copied and the manager writes the scope itself. The study decision is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Pull dated schedule, cost, and permit facts for the status.
Draft written status sentences that each cite one fact.

loop.purpose: Bind each status sentence to one fact id.
loop.input: A sentence and the fact pack.
loop.output: The sentence with a fact id, or a gap.
loop.check: The fact id is in the pack, and the number in the sentence is the number on that fact.
loop.stop: Stop when a sentence has no fact id or states a number the fact does not hold.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed monthly template cannot tell which sentence states a number the pulled facts do not hold.

steps.what: Provide verbal status to teams, management, subcontractors, customers, or owners.
Send the accepted written project status reports.

tasks.design: Dated schedule, cost, and permit facts are pulled from {ERP} and {PROJECT}. Written status sentences are drafted only where each sentence cites one of those facts. The manager provides the verbal status to the team, management, subcontractors, customers, or owners, and accepts or rejects the written text. {EMAIL} sends only the accepted report.
tasks.previous_blocker: The written report was rebuilt from memory, and the numbers drifted from the ledger.
tasks.enabler_now: The facts can be pulled, and a sentence with no fact id can be stopped.
tasks.still_hard: What the audience needs to hear, and whether the written wording is fair, is the manager's call.
tasks.human_edge: The manager speaks the status and decides which written sentences go out.

ambition.what: A written status that cites the facts on the day they change, not only at the monthly meeting.

tasks.altitude: The verbal status stays with the manager. A written report leaves only after the manager accepts the sentences.

reach.task: Report operating status to the owner.
reach.learn: A sentence with no fact id is not sent.

evidence.claim: Status sentences can be drafted from facts the company has already pulled. A sentence with no fact id should not stand.

Generated text sent to customers or owners is reviewed by the manager before it goes. EU AI Act article 50 expects a person to review generated content that informs others, unless that review is already the editorial control.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A fact id is required on every written sentence. A sentence with no fact id is not drafted. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: The number in a sentence must match the fact. The draft adds no commentary.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the development manager.
unknowns: Whether owners receive the written report or only hear the verbal status.
research_questions: Which status numbers are still taken from a side sheet rather than the ledger?

already_counted.description: Giving the verbal status and accepting the written text stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Read the draft against the fact pack before the status meeting.

approvals.approved_version: report version and the fact ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes many facts have no id, so the manager writes the report by hand and still gives the verbal status. High assumes the fact pack is complete and only the accepted sentences are sent. The meeting is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Recalculate schedules, estimates, forecasts, and budgets for wind projects.
Review the update before it replaces those figures.
Replace the baseline with the accepted update.

tasks.design: Schedules, estimates, forecasts, and budgets are recalculated in {ERP} from posted actuals. The manager reviews the update and decides whether it replaces the baseline. A figure with no actual id is not recalculated. The proposal is not the baseline until the manager accepts it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actuals were retyped into the forecast, and the baseline moved without a clear version.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted actuals can be recalculated into a proposal the manager then accepts or rejects.
tasks.still_hard: Whether this week's actuals should move the baseline is a judgement about the rest of the project.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides if the update is the new baseline or only a view of the actuals.

ambition.what: Whether the forecast baseline should change in the week the actuals are posted.

tasks.altitude: The baseline changes only when the manager accepts the update. The recalculation is not that acceptance.

reach.task: Update a construction forecast from actuals.
reach.learn: Posted actuals propose a change. The manager accepts the baseline.

evidence.claim: Schedules and budgets can be recalculated from actuals the ledger already holds. The manager decides if the baseline changes.
Commentary on a forecast has to be checked against the figures. The figures do not explain themselves.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: An actual id and a baseline id are required. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: The proposal uses posted amounts only. It does not invent a forecast comment.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the development manager.
unknowns: Whether the company treats every actuals week as a baseline change or only the month end.
research_questions: Which forecast lines are still typed rather than taken from posted actuals?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the update and deciding whether it becomes the baseline stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Check the proposal uses the actuals week the manager expects.

approvals.approved_version: forecast version and the actual ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes actuals are missing ids, so the manager updates the sheets by hand. High assumes posted actuals recalculate cleanly and the manager only reviews the change. The baseline does not move until acceptance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The development manager still supervises subcontractors, still writes the scope, and still gives the status in person. A forecast can be recalculated from posted actuals. The manager still decides whether that update becomes the baseline.
reach: Wind energy operations managers inherit the as-built record, and this job learns a status report cites the facts it uses.
Compliance managers keep the obligation with a named owner, and this job learns a scope heading is not the study.
skills_to_grow: Supervise quality against the specification without turning the checklist into a score of a person.
Write a scope that says what the study must cover, in the manager's own words.
Accept a forecast update only after the figures match the posted actuals.
role.ambitious_version: A status report that leaves the team cites only facts pulled that day, and a forecast baseline changes only when the manager accepts that update.
